name: googlebooks-app
description: Full-stack Google Books search app with React, Apollo GraphQL, Express, and MongoDB

scripts.develop: concurrently "npm --prefix server run watch" "npm --prefix client start"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run test && npm run audit:prod
scripts.audit:prod: npm audit --omit=dev && npm --prefix server audit --omit=dev && npm --prefix client audit --omit=dev
